Presented by Amanda Foster, We Will Find a Way, LLC. Visit meeting link or dial: 4724 PIN: -280-(US) +1 832311 169 654# For questions, please contact Meghan at meghan_smallwood@hcpss.org or (443) 355-7733. This event is sponsored by HCPSS and aligns with the questions about the school system offering training about special education issues and providing information on agencies that can assist in the transition from school on the MDSE parent survey that is sent to families of students with an IEP or IFSP annually. Free

description_full: MONTHLY SECAC MEETING - BEYOND PERFECT: UNDERSTANDING PERFECTIONISM AND BURNOUT IN AUTISTIC, ADHD, AND 2E YOUTH Tuesday, December 1, 2026 6:30-8:30 p.m. Virtual Event We are excited to welcome Dr. Jeannette M. Reid, licensed psychologist with the Center for Anxiety & Behavioral Change, for an informative discussion on how perfectionism and burnout affect neurodivergent youth. During this session, we will explore school avoidance, demand avoidance, and practical strategies parents and educators can use to better support students. Visit registration page. Sponsored by SECAC. Free
